title: CNSS Skill D canonical-state and high-bit fault isolation
objective: Separate canonical workspace reconstruction, adapter transformation error and decoder sensitivity as explanations for rank-32 modular-addition failures.
diagnostics: carry count and maximum consecutive carry-chain length
signed decoder margins at canonical and actual states
Pearson and Spearman correlations without linearity assumptions
matched controls for high-bit error masks
controls: all rank-32 checkpoints, not test-selected checkpoints
interpretation_rule: The audit may localize observed errors and compare interventions, but it cannot establish an internal carry algorithm, a unique representation defect or a new learned capability without a separate causal experiment.
